sacraments.text: Usually the first Saturday of alternate months at 14:00, with a compulsory parent and godparent briefing the Saturday before. Next: baptism 7 November 2026, briefing 31 October. Return the form in person by the deadline with the child’s birth certificate, parents’ and godparents’ baptism certificates, and parents’ civil and church marriage certificates. Adoption documents must be approved first. At least one godparent must be a baptised, confirmed, practising Catholic. Group baptism; no fee. Check the date with the parish office.

Contact a priest when seriously ill, without waiting until critically ill. Home visits/prayers available for bedbound people; parish responsible within its boundaries, or contact a church near the hospital.
Call Parish Office during office hours to arrange.

Check church availability with Parish Office before arranging with undertakers and booking. Funeral Mass usually about 1.5 hours before cremation. Basement Divine Mercy Chapel accepts wakes for baptised Catholics; supply baptism certificate/extract with booking form available at office.
First Reconciliation and Communion typically Primary 3; Confirmation Secondary 3.
Niches for immediate use and baptised Catholics only. Deceased’s baptism and death certificates required.
